geopolitics_summary: Slovakia blocks EU Russia sanctions lock-in; US-Iran tensions escalate; EU debates fossil fuel finance exclusions amid budget pressures.

themes.headline: Slovakia rejects EU plan to lock Russia sanctions for 12 months
themes.why_it_matters: Slovakia holdout on sanctions renewal raises risk of EU energy embargo weakening or Russian gas flows resuming. Direct TTF upside if sanctions erode; downward power price pressure if cheap Russian gas re-enters.

themes.headline: EU Parliament wants tighter fossil fuel exclusions under sustainable finance rules
themes.why_it_matters: Stricter fossil fuel exclusions in SFDR will raise cost of capital for gas/coal generation, suppressing supply and lifting power prices and EUA demand. Parliament vs. member states disagreement may delay implementation but signals carbon-unfavorable policy direction.

themes.headline: Climate change threatens Europe's nuclear renaissance; rising temperatures stress fleet
themes.why_it_matters: Higher river/ambient temperatures reduce nuclear cooling capacity and output, tightening EU power supply. Direct DA/Cal+1 spread risk; forces reliance on gas/coal peaking capacity. Structural supply risk in low-water summers.

themes.headline: Power-hungry data centers expanding in Europe amid local resistance
themes.why_it_matters: Large-scale data center deployments increase baseline power demand structurally; Google expansion in Austria signals strong continental demand growth. Upside to Cal+1 and multi-year power curve; potential stress on regional transmission.

themes.headline: U.S. LNG exports rose 23% in first half 2026; higher capacity driving volumes
themes.why_it_matters: Increased US LNG supply (17.4 Bcf/d, +23% YoY) strengthens global LNG market and lowers arbitrage spreads to Europe. Potential downward pressure on TTF via improved LNG arb window; reduces EU gas price support and softens power curve.

watchlist: EU budget negotiation timeline and potential new fossil fuel / carbon taxes (Costa, Ribera proposals)
Slovakia sanctions vote outcome and any EU Russia energy embargo modifications
SFDR / fossil fuel exclusion rules finalization and capital cost impacts on EU thermal generation
Iran-US escalation trajectory; any Strait of Hormuz risk or crude/LNG supply disruption
